en: Follow the public circulation signs toward the Montreal Children's Hospital (Blocks B/A).
fr: Suivez la circulation publique vers l’Hôpital de Montréal pour enfants (blocs B/A).
es: Tome los ascensores hasta el nivel 2.
Siga las señales de circulación pública hacia el Hospital Infantil de Montreal (bloques B/A).
pt: Pegue os elevadores até o nível 2.
Siga as placas de circulação pública em direção ao Hospital Infantil de Montreal (blocos B/A).
ar: اتبع لافتات الممر العام باتجاه مستشفى مونتريال للأطفال (المبنيان B/A).
he: עקבו אחר השילוט למעבר הציבורי לכיוון בית החולים לילדים של מונטריאול (בניינים B/A).
ru: Следуйте указателям общественного прохода к Монреальской детской больнице (блоки B/A).
vi: Đi theo biển chỉ dẫn lối đi công cộng về phía Bệnh viện Nhi Montreal (khối B/A).
sw: Fuata alama za njia ya umma kuelekea Hospitali ya Watoto ya Montreal (Majengo B/A).
bg: Следвайте указателните табели за обществено движение към Детската болница в Монреал (блокове B/A).

routingNotes.A-B: Blocks A and B form the Montreal Children's Hospital sector in the official MUHC Glen wayfinding directory.
routingNotes.C-D: Blocks C and D form the Royal Victoria Hospital adult sector; Block D also contains Cedars Cancer Centre and Montreal Chest Institute.
routingNotes.cross-sector: The official MUHC Glen wayfinding map identifies public circulation across Blocks A/B/C/D on Level 2. WayWey uses Level 2 as the validated public cross-sector route between the Montreal Children's Hospital and Royal Victoria/Cedars sectors.
routingNotes.E: Research Institute public routing is not yet encoded.
